The URL configuration mounts Django's debug media file server with static(settings.MEDIA_URL, document_root=settings.MEDIA_ROOT). Because DEBUG defaults to True, uploaded documents are served directly from disk without authentication, bypassing the document_download authorization checks (e.g., internal/customer visibility controls).

SECRET_KEY falls back to a hardcoded development value ("dev-only-change-me") when the DJANGO_SECRET_KEY environment variable is not set, which would allow signature forgery and session compromise if used in production.
The database PASSWORD defaults to the hardcoded value "crm_saas" when the POSTGRES_PASSWORD environment variable is not set, exposing the database if the defaults are used in production.
DEBUG defaults to True when DJANGO_DEBUG is not set, which would expose sensitive debug pages and stack traces in production.
